summary.en: External-search discovery was not observed. After receiving a URL, three agents used only public information to run five problems in four executions, check numerical criteria, and produce scoped citations and terms summaries. Unprompted search-to-execution remains unconfirmed.

protocol.search: Fixed four unbranded queries, once each, before providing the site URL to the two search evaluators.
protocol.url_assisted: Three separate agent contexts received only the homepage URL and problem goals. No repository, prior output or CI receipt was permitted as an execution substitute.
protocol.isolation_limit: Instructional source isolation, fresh scratch folders and venvs on one shared macOS host; not separate hardware or OS-enforced read isolation.
protocol.sampling: Five purpose-selected representative problems, not a randomized benchmark, all fifteen CI examples, or all sixty atlas problems.
protocol.execution_mode: Direct published example runners; no published full-suite CI/bootstrap/verifier used by the agents. Each agent wrote its own checks. Parent subsequently rechecked generated artifacts with the published verifier criteria.

limitations: URL-assisted success is not external-search discovery, adoption by all AI products, or evidence of future model training.
This observation used macOS arm64 with Python 3.9.6/3.12.16. Prior fresh-Linux fifteen-case CI is separate evidence.
He uses a saved finite-basis PySCF reference; the agent did not regenerate that reference. HF and exchange-only LDA are not general molecular DFT.
Sod uses a same-codebase self-similar reference with numerical root finding, not an independent external solver.
Normal checks, output checks, expected nonconvergence, setup-helper errors and literature-access failures are different categories.
